mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.role AS user_role FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT c.id AS couple_id, c.groom_id AS groom_id, c.bride_id AS bride_id, me.id AS user_id, me.name AS user_name, me.role AS user_role, partner.id AS partner_user_id, partner.name AS partner_name, partner.role AS partner_role, c.status AS couple_status FROM couple c INNER JOIN `user` me ON me.id = #{userId} AND me.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN `user` partner ON partner.id = CASE WHEN c.groom_id = #{userId} THEN c.bride_id WHEN c.bride_id = #{userId} THEN c.groom_id END AND partner.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE c.status = #{connectedStatus} AND (c.groom_id = #{userId} OR c.bride_id = #{userId}) AND c.groom_id IS NOT NULL AND c.bride_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card cd WHERE cd.user_id = #{userId} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.wedding_fund IS NOT NULL AND u.is_deleted = FALSE ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goal g WHERE g.couple_id = #{coupleId} AND g.status IN (#{normalStatus}, #{pendingStatus}, #{confirmedStatus}) ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS wedding_goal_created, main_goal.id AS main_goal_id, main_goal.status AS main_goal_status, DATE_FORMAT(main_goal.wedding_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS wedding_date, NULLIF(TRIM(main_goal.region), '') AS region FROM ( SELECT 1 AS checklist_base ) base LEFT JOIN goal main_goal ON main_goal.id = ( SELECT g.id FROM goal g WHERE g.couple_id = #{coupleId} AND g.is_main = TRUE AND g.status = #{confirmedStatus} ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

SELECT g.total_budget AS total_budget_amount, CAST(FLOOR( g.total_budget * CASE WHEN #{userId} = #{groomId} THEN g.groom_ratio ELSE g.bride_ratio END / 100 ) AS SIGNED) AS personal_target_amount, DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS base_date FROM goal g WHERE g.id = #{goalId}
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.wedding_fund AS wedding_fund FROM `user` u WHERE u.id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) AND u.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT sr.user_id AS user_id, sr.type AS record_type, COALESCE(sr.changed_category, sr.category) AS category, SUM(sr.amount) AS amount, 'SERVICE' AS source FROM service_record sr WHERE sr.user_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) GROUP BY sr.user_id, sr.type, COALESCE(sr.changed_category, sr.category)
SELECT ws.region AS region, ws.category AS category, ws.mid_50 AS balanced_amount FROM wedding_statistics ws ORDER BY ws.region ASC, ws.category ASC
SELECT n.type AS alert_type, n.title AS title, n.content AS message, n.created_at AS created_at FROM notification n WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(n.id) FROM notification n WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.is_read = FALSE
